newsitem.title: ITALY: STET/Telecom savings share margins widened - source.
newsitem.headline: STET/Telecom savings share margins widened - source.

text.p: The trading margin for the savings shares in Italian telecoms holding STET and telecoms operator Telecom Italia are to be widened to 20 percent from 10 percent, said share market sources on Monday.

The two savings shares were suspended after falling sharply today after the Italian Treasury said on Friday that these savings shares would not be converted into ordinary shares when STET and Telecom Italia are merged.
The saving shares will started trading again with the wider margins at 1110 GMT, said share operators.
STET savings shares closed at 6,699 lire on Friday while Telecom Italia savings shares ended at 3,804 lire.
